sections.introduction:
Receding gums are a condition in which the gums pull back from the tooth surface and expose the root surface. When there is recession of gums the teeth and the gum line make it easy for the deposits of bacterial infection to build up, is a common dental problem. The main characteristic of gingival recession is migration and later it gets displaced from the cementoenamel junction which further exposes the root surface. This is mainly due to poor oral hygiene which leads to tooth loss.In this condition bacteria in the mouth infect the tissue leads to inflammation which further causes periodontal disease, when bacteria stays for long period of time they form plaque which hardens and causes tartar they spread to gum line and makes teeth harder to clean. And creates a breeding site of many bacteria and plaque. 


 Facts 

 Periodontal disease is not limited to eldrly people 
 It can be hereditary 
 Periodontitis is linked to many ailments such as diabetes (as diabetic patients are more prone as it is unable to maintain the regular glucose level), Cancer (as it increases the overall cancer risk), stroke (risk of getting ischemic stroke). 
 Gum disease is contagious – As bacteria can be passed to another saliva and can be spread from person to person. 
 Dairy products helps to prevent periodontal disease (as they are rich in calcium so prevents many gums disease) 
 Chronic bad breath is a sign of gum disease (as bacteria produces foul breath). 
 Pregnant women who have high risk of gum disease put their child at high risk as in later stages bacteria reaches the bloodstream and causes problems once they reach the placenta .

 Abstract

Its early stage is gingivitis (where there is swelling and red gums which may bleed further), Than it causes serious form periodontitis. This condition is more common in males than females. Gingival recession is when the apical margin is away from the occlusal surface. Gums are mucosal tissue that lies over the mandible and maxilla inside the mouth. There are various warning signs such as : loose teeth, painful chewing, swollen gums, and bad breath. In this topic we will discuss its causes, risk factors, herbal remedies, and prevention of this disease in detail.

During another graft the gingival graft tissue is directly taken from the mouth.
